blocks.title: Read Me First
rows: Filled by Raghav at end of each branch day. Visible to Manisha, Saurabh, CBO, Founder.
Raghav fills one row per branch day. End of day, before the daily Google Meet.
Manisha and Saurabh review this before the daily call. The call agenda comes from what is in this log + the Decisions Log.
Don't write essays. Short, specific, honest. If a day was hard, say it was hard. If a finding is uncomfortable, log it anyway. The point is transparency.
Owner: Raghav Khanna. Visible to: Manisha (Sales Head), Saurabh (Ops Manager), CBO, Founder.

blocks.title: Daily Field Log
rows: Daily Field Log  ·  Raghav Khanna  ·  Regional Head
Sentiment uses Green / Amber / Red. Green = day went well. Amber = some friction or open item. Red = significant issue, escalation needed. Be honest — Red days are not failures, they are signals.
